integratorId.title: Swapper integrator id
integratorId.description: Your own Swapper integrator id: a dashboard with your deposit statistics, webhooks and other custom settings. Get one from the Swapper team at https://swapper.finance/sync. Leave empty to use the id Swapper configured for this plugin.

destinationToken.title: Default receive token
destinationToken.description: Token credited to the Orderly account by default, e.g. USDC.

tokens.title: Receive tokens
tokens.description: Comma-separated allow-list for the receive-token picker, e.g. "USDC,USDT,ETH". Leave empty to list every Orderly collateral token.

chainLogo.title: Destination logo URL
chainLogo.description: Logo the widget shows as the place the funds land. Leave empty to use your DEX logo (the img of appIcons, secondary then main). Absolute or page-relative http(s) URL, same-origin with your DEX or served with CORS headers; otherwise Orderly's logo shows.

chainName.title: Destination name
chainName.description: Name the widget shows as the place the funds land. Leave empty to use your broker name.

depositMethods.title: Deposit methods
depositMethods.description: Comma-separated subset of walletDeposit, transferCrypto, depositWithCash, depositFromPolymarket, depositFromPerps. Leave empty for every method enabled for your integrator.

minDepositUsd.title: Minimum deposit (USD)
minDepositUsd.description: Leave empty to use your integrator's minimum.

themeMode.title: Theme
themeMode.description: Widget theme. Leave empty to follow your DEX theme.

matchOrderlyTheme.title: Match DEX theme
matchOrderlyTheme.description: Derive widget colours, surfaces and radius from your DEX theme and follow theme switches.

primaryColor.title: Primary colour
primaryColor.description: Brand colour override, any CSS colour.

height.title: Initial widget height (px)
height.description: Height of deposit-method screens until the widget reports its own.

widgetPadding.title: Widget padding (px)
widgetPadding.description: Padding inside the widget. The default lines the widget up with Orderly's form fields in the Deposit dialog.

preload.title: Preload widget
preload.description: Load the widget in the background once a wallet connects, so Deposit opens instantly. Nothing loads before a wallet connects, and never on testnet. Off: the widget loads when Deposit is first opened.

useHostWallet.title: Use connected wallet
useHostWallet.description: Hand the EVM wallet connected to your DEX to the widget, so traders don't connect twice.

injectStyles.title: Inject stylesheet
injectStyles.description: Add the plugin's stylesheet as a style tag. Turn off under a Content Security Policy that blocks inline styles, and load dist/styles.css instead.
